note: Vendored copy of the product API's normative telemetry refusal contract. The runtime must classify the statuses it records, so it is a conformance fixture. Digests detect a local edit; the source commit is the provenance trail. Upstream drift needs a checkout of a private repository, so scripts/refresh-telemetry-refusal-fixture.sh is a maintainer check rather than a CI gate; the fixture's own generator is the upstream gate.

excluded.telemetry_refusals.snapshot.json: Marked "normative": false upstream. It captures header order, casing and Content-Length, which are the HTTP client's rather than the contract's, so pinning it would move this digest on a dependency bump that changed no behaviour.
